title: KP14 vyge (exposure on the profitability deviation, b_f 0.1/0.25/0.45) with a visible level ladder type_level [0.6, 1.0, 1.6]
question: Does revealing the type through size turn the hidden-type x profitability product into room and a gap, as a partly revealed type did in the reduced form?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-31 01:00). vyge's first oracle has room of 12%: the exposure b_f (eps - 1) is mean zero within type and a0 is type-free, so the type is invisible, the three types earn the same premium (0.34 / 0.36 / 0.35 %/mo), and a product of a hidden type and a visible state is learnable by nobody. The reduced form's latent-product ladder gives room only when the type is partly revealed. type_level (new in kp_vy, BGN's parameter) multiplies each type's cash-flow level: size reveals the type, ROE reveals eps, and the premium b_f (eps - 1) is a product of two visible characteristics that no linear function of ranks holds (bvychs30's structure, now in KP14). In KP14 the level changes only the characteristics.
